selectionRuleAsApplied.primaryMetric: raw gate admission / 20 (pre-registered; counts author failures as non-admissions)
selectionRuleAsApplied.appliedRule: top rate wins; exact rate ties -> cheaper; a CI-overlapping candidate displaces the top only when cheaper by more than 2x (beyond wall-clock co-tenancy noise). Stated before W9 ran.
selectionRuleAsApplied.costDefinition: cost = (inputTokens + outputTokens) * arm wall seconds. Anthropic thinking tokens are folded into outputTokens by the gateway (they rise 9k->337k with effort), so families are comparable; wall seconds carry >40% co-tenancy noise, so sub-2x differences are not evidence.
selectionRuleAsApplied.note: the literal cheapest-CI-overlapping reading names claude-fable-5/low (rate 0.65) on a 1.3% cost margin inside >40% wall-clock co-tenancy noise; disclosed and rejected rather than silently applied

w7VersusW9.verdict: W9 is nominally ahead on BOTH splits and the improvement is larger on HELDOUT than DEV (no overfitting signature), but neither delta is statistically significant. Supportable claim: sol/low is at least as good as luna/medium, strictly more reliable (0/208 vs sweep 4+/100 author failures), and cheaper at low effort. The binding constraint remains the map inventory, not the authoring model.
